notes.title: The latest update for the demo is now live!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, travelers![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227284/f03d39f81c3cd93383cf0321351f27c45870de11.gif[/img]
The latest update for the demo is now live!

[h3]Key Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced new risk mechanics, adding more depth to decision-making.
[*] Expanded scenario branches for choices with risk-based outcomes.
[*] Improved UI navigation. (arrows and clicks functionality on all pages)
[*] Refined text with corrected spelling and punctuation.
[*] Addressed various player-reported bugs for a smoother experience.
[/list]

A huge thank you to everyone playing the demo and providing feedback — your insights are invaluable for us and significantly help improving the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270710/Dekadant_Demo/

[h3]Exciting News![/h3]

We're also thrilled to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Valkyrie_Initiative]Valkyrie Initiative[/url] is now officially publishing the game! With their support, we can fully focus on development and bring the best experience possible.

[h3]Add the game to your wishlist! More updates coming soon.[/h3]

Join our growing community on [url=https://discord.gg/s75wTynudK]Discord[/url], share your thoughts, and ask questions—I’ll do my best to respond to everyone!

notes.title: New Year's Eve Demo Update
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we've been working hard and managed to release an updated build of the game's demo version.
Key changes:

Navigation optimization: You can now turn pages forward by clicking either the left or right page, which is more intuitive for players. Additionally, navigation arrows for going back are now only displayed when active.
Visual improvements: We've made tab icons more contrasting, added shaders to artwork making them more dynamic. Moreover, character stat increases are now more visually noticeable.
Complete overhaul of the save system, fixing all related bugs.

The next major patch is expected in a month. We plan to implement significant story changes and introduce a new failure check mechanic for choices.

notes.title: Update of the demo version of Decadant
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we have released an updated build of the demo version of the game.
Main changes:
1) added a tooltip function for displaying historical information. Now in the game, when you meet real historical characters, you can get a brief historical background that better reveals the world of the game and the context of what is happening. Therefore, if you see that some words in the text in the scenes are highlighted in bold, feel free to hover your cursor over them.

2) some of the player’s choices affect not only the protagonist’s stats and future scenes, but will also subsequently lead to changes that affect the final ending of the game. In this case, the player will receive a pop-up message "Attention! The world has changed."


Minor changes:
-- fixed errors in drawn art
-- drew new character icons (sister in childhood, Emperor Alexander, main character in early childhood)
-- removed spelling and grammatical errors in the text of scenes
